what: Pressing the hamburger unfolds a rounded menu panel below the button, pivoting on its top-left corner, from .25 scale and transparent over .5s cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1). Each row slides in from 4rem to the right, delayed by .07×(index+1)+.1s, over 1s expo.out(.16,1,.3,1), and the text rises from below by its own height over .5s. The three hamburger lines turn into an X in .3s (top −45°, middle and bottom 45°). On close, all rows leave together after a .3s delay. Press again, click outside the panel, or hit Esc to close.

options.shift: Distance the line is pushed in, default 4rem
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open and close button — inside <i> Place three and it turns into X

from.where: shared.css .fx-menu·.fx-menu__slide·.fx-burger — original header menu (scale-25 → 100 · duration-500 ease-in-out-expo · line translate-x 4rem duration-1000 ease-out-expo · delay .07(i+1)+.1s · close .3s)

note: The section’s position is set by whoever uses it (the part only uses transform·opacity·pointer-events). While open, data-open is attached to the element. The original class was ease-in-out-expo, but the curve actually measured was easeOutQuart, so that is used
